state.background: Independently judge the supplied logical scenarios for faithful replacement by Vitest Browser Mode, using the exact contract and source assertions per question. Plan45's fixed denominator A is every active logical E2E scenario; retain ineligible rows in A. E counts only faithful Browser Mode replacements without requiring the Next production integration boundary. Browser Mode DOM mounting can test component DOM, keyboard/focus behavior, and simple style or viewport-input behavior when assertions can be preserved. Actual component DOM/keyboard/focus and simple style/viewport-input cases may qualify. Cases whose required failure boundary is Next production build/start/route, Flight/hydration, production URL routing, production download, actual layout placement/overflow/scroll/SVG/chart geometry/coordinate hit-testing, or required WebKit-specific behavior remain Playwright (or another appropriate existing layer). Pure computation/unit-only contracts belong in unit/elsewhere, not Browser Mode. Viewport-only styling is case-by-case: classify eligible if only input/state and resulting computed style/DOM contract are asserted, but not eligible if actual rendered geometry/overflow/placement is measured. Distinguish project variants when the condition changes (color scheme, viewport, or engine); logical inputs remain separate as presented. Do not infer current eligibility labels: none are supplied. Choose unresolved only where this evidence is genuinely insufficient to judge the faithful boundary.
acceptanceCriteria: Each question is one stable Plan45 logical scenario ID and has exact source assertion/action evidence and its project/viewport/color/engine/input condition.
Classify only as eligible, not_eligible, or unresolved under the fixed definition in common state.
All 123 distinct IDs are answered exactly once across deterministic batches; preserve each given project and loop/input variant.
A=123. For feasibility, M/A>0.50 is possible only if at least 62 of 123 could migrate; derive totals after all answers, counting unresolved separately and eligible upper bound as eligible+unresolved.
knownConstraints: No application changes; no test/build execution requested.
No prior classifications are included or authoritative.
Plan42 phase1/2 remain incomplete independently; do not infer otherwise.
state.outputRequirement: For each keyed scenario question, return exactly one of its three choices. Do not add free-text diagnosis. A response answer map should use the exact stable question IDs as keys.
